problems.fix: Preserve all current validators, their order/messages, calculations, payloads, submit/catch behavior and draft values. Add Party-local presentation error state, stable translated field/error associations and focus to the first deterministically invalid control after local review/save failure; use a focusable existing error summary for a submission/domain error that cannot safely identify a field. problems.evidence: T7/T12 and guide §§9/30. PartyPaymentDialog97, PartyCreditRefundDialog90, PartyFinanceDialog94–95 and PartyTransactionDialog94–95 consume FinancePaymentSplitEditor. Its Input at src/components/finance/FinancePaymentSplitEditor.tsx:87–93 has only value, decimal mode, class, change handler and numeric placeholder; the row59 is a div, with no connected label/id/aria-label/aria-labelledby. Input.tsx24–25 routes it to NumericInput; NumericInput.tsx48 forwards supplied props to the real input and only uses its inferred label on steppers59–61. Thus the actual split amount has no meaningful accessible name, including in source correction. No runtime accessible-tree assertion is claimed. Both independent round-three reports converge on this finding; recovery checker independently inspected the affected source at c7e641d.
problems.fix: Add a narrowly optional presentation API to the shared split editor and opt in only from Party payment, refund, finance and correction consumers. Each amount must have a translated task/row-specific accessible name for one and multiple rows. Keep default markup/behavior for all other consumers, row values, method/account choices, normalization, parsers, validators and calculations unchanged. Coordinate error description/invalid state with the related validation finding.
